title: DSI DTCG extension
description: Value of $extensions["io.nonoun.dsi"] on every native token in data/native. Records where the token came from. Extraction time and package integrity live in the version's manifest.json, so token files are byte-stable across runs.

package.description: Package the token was read from (the main package or one of the source's dependencies).

nativeName.description: The name exactly as shipped, e.g. --md-sys-color-error or $support-error.

theme.description: Native theme the value came from.

specDivergence.description: Known difference from the documented spec. A note only; shipped code wins.

rawValue.description: The value exactly as the product computes it (Sass meta.inspect for Material). For aliases, the resolved value, used to verify the alias.

untyped.description: The literal fits no DTCG type (e.g. a CSS font shorthand); $value holds it as a string and $type is absent.

visibility.description: internal: shipped in the package but not part of its public API (e.g. Polaris's palette behind its CSS variables). Absent means public.
